headline: Mon Oct 26: NFL 1-0 (McKee under 1.5 TDs), NBA 2-1. Week 7 NFL final: top 10 10-2.

findings: Surest hit: Tanner McKee under 1.5 passing TDs (72%), finished with 1.
Monday night closed Week 7: the NFL top 10 finished 10-2 and picks of the day 3-1.

Week 7 misses: Tony Pollard under 68.5 rushing yards (ran for 129) and Adonai Mitchell over 25.5 receiving yards (0 catches) on the top 10; Aaron Jones over 38.5 rushing yards (26) was the one pick of the day that lost.

checks.text: Week 7 is fully graded. Monday's fix (#22) stopped picks being voided as "did not play" when the final score posted hours before the player stats.
Week 8: 242 picks and 14 game simulations saved ahead of Thursday. Rosters, injuries and prices refresh Thursday morning before kickoff.
2026 defensive participation data isn't published by nflverse yet, so coverage schemes still lean on 2025 charting plus Week 7.

postgame: Post-game re-sims ran on 13 Week 7 games. For rushing yards, knowing who played, the team's volume and each player's role would have cut the typical miss from 29.1 to 14.4 yards. Most of that came from roles.
Carry share keeps running above the pregame input (+3.1 percentage points over 90 players). We're watching it and haven't made an automatic correction.

PIT-NO hand re-sim (London game): leans 14-5, Strong/Solid 7-0. Running back target share was set too low on both teams (Dowdle 11% pregame vs 21% actual, Kamara 11% vs 18%), and inactive backup QBs were given carry share.
All graded NFL picks, top tiers and long shots included: 239 of 529 hit (45.2%) vs the 43.3% the site predicted, so they're slightly better than calibrated.
improving: Efficiency corrections retested on 25 recent weeks: catch rate +0.0004, yards per target −0.0004, yards per carry +0.0005. None cleared its 90% interval, so none was adopted.
The simulation blend stays on where it helps on unseen weeks: carries (+0.021), rushing yards (+0.011), rush+rec yards, receptions and receiving yards. It stays off for passing markets.
Team volume learned from the post-game reviews: passes x1.029, runs x0.997 (teams threw 1.4 more passes per game than the pregame inputs said over Weeks 4-7).

findings: No college picks were played Monday. Saturday's top 10 went 15-3 and picks of the day 3-0 (Texas State, Arizona, Kentucky).

checks.text: 2,836 college game-line prices saved Monday morning; 288 odds credits left this month.

Found a bug: Saturday games were graded on Friday's frozen picks (freeze kept the first run). Fixed in #24, which re-freezes every pre-kickoff run, so grading now matches what the site showed at kickoff.

postgame: Weekly review: on all 51 games with a posted line, totals went 22-28-1. The suggested totals (Lean/Strong) went 8-5, and the coin flips went 14-22-1.
The model's totals miss equals the closing line's (12.2 points). The edge holds against opening totals (Strong 59% all-time, 55% recent), not closing ones.
improving: Tested and rejected (walk-forward, no gain): recent defensive form in totals, pace x explosive-play matchups for shootouts, and pregame QB changes. The apparent effect of a new starter came from mid-game injuries the model couldn't have known about.
Next tests: lock totals at the earliest posted line, and keep the dog-moneyline 7+ bets (+4% ROI all-time, about 0 recently, so variance rather than a broken signal).

findings: Top 10: Christian Braun under 1.5 threes hit (finished with 1).
Picks of the day 1-1: Stephen Curry under 4.5 threes hit (3). P.J. Washington under 2.5 threes missed (4 made in 41 minutes vs 32 projected, so it was the minutes, not his shooting).
Javon Small (pick of the day) hasn't played a game this season. He was locked before the starter rule (#27) and will grade as void once the next box scores post.
All 730 graded leans across 9 games: 66% hit (483-247). Leans at 70%+ hit 83% (193), 65-70% hit 71%, 60-65% hit 62%, and coin flips (50-60%) hit 56%.

checks.text: Box scores through Sun Oct 25 were in for Monday's slate, and Monday's games posted overnight.
The league's official injury report was added Monday (#29) but couldn't be read (#33 fixed the season page; the PDF format was still failing), so the ESPN injury list was used.
Starter rule now uses this season (#27): a pick needs 1+ game, 60%+ starts and 24+ minutes when there's no book line. It caught Javon Small (0 games) and Bub Carrington (bench).

postgame: Minutes: players averaged 2.0 fewer minutes than projected (typical miss 6.0) over 158 players.
Re-run with the minutes actually played, 112 of the 247 losing leans would have been right, so minutes drove 45% of the misses.
Projections by market were close: points −0.5, PRA −0.7, rebounds, assists and threes within ±0.2 per player.
Biggest miss was Walter Clayton Jr. (four unders at 81-94%). He played fewer minutes than projected (17 vs 20) and still scored 15. That was production, not minutes.
improving: All 5 NBA markets passed the walk-forward gate on the morning refit (points, rebounds, assists, threes, PRA).
The team scoring check stays on: on unseen seasons, 65%+ leans hit 66.7% with it vs 65.9% without.
